title: AI reaches families when proof and safety ship with the product
description: Why builders in high-trust domains need proof and safety controls in the product before distribution.
tldr: AI reaches families when proof and safety ship with the product. In high-trust domains, builders need progress evidence before distribution and should measure before they ship broadly.

sections.h2: why does proof need to ship with the product?
body: Families engage with AI when the product carries visible evidence of progress and safety. The finding is simple: distribution depends on more than the product experience alone.
Builders in high-trust domains need a receipt that shows what has been measured before wider distribution begins.

sections.h2: when should safety controls enter the product?
body: Safety controls belong in the product from the start. They shape how the product earns trust as it reaches families.
Adding safeguards early keeps proof and safety connected to the product itself, where users encounter them.

sections.h2: what should builders measure before they distribute?
body: The source question is the operating prompt: what are you measuring before you distribute? Progress evidence and safety should travel together when the product moves toward wider use.
Ship the receipt with the safeguards so the evidence behind distribution is part of the product experience.

faqs.q: How can AI products earn trust with families?
faqs.a: Ship proof and safety with the product. Families need progress evidence and safeguards to be present as the product reaches them.

faqs.q: When should safety controls be added to an AI product?
faqs.a: Safety controls belong in the product from the start. They should develop alongside the product rather than appearing only at distribution.

faqs.q: What should builders measure before distributing AI products?
faqs.a: Measure progress evidence and safety before distribution. The receipt of what has been measured should ship with the safeguards.
